component.name: Card
component.description: A generic surface container that groups related content with consistent padding, border-radius, and optional elevation. Use to visually separate page sections or form groups. Card is slot-based (children-only) and carries no content structure of its own — for course display use CardVertical or CardHorizontal instead.

useWhen: Grouping a set of related form fields or content items into a distinct visual section
A page section needs a distinct background to separate it from the page canvas
Displaying a content item (course, article, product) in a list or grid
A feature or selected state needs visual elevation above sibling content

notFor.case: Using Card as a full-page background
notFor.because: Card is a grouping surface, not a page background. A full-page card makes every section a nested container.
notFor.note: Use Box background='canvas' (or the container-canvas token) on the root layout element.

notFor.case: Using Card to display a course (with image, title, metadata)
notFor.because: Card is children-based and carries no content structure. Course display requires fixed structure (image zone, title, metadata row, optional progress).
notFor.note: Use CardVertical for catalog grids or CardHorizontal for course lists and footers.

patterns.name: form-section
patterns.description: A Card wrapping a Stack of form inputs, used to group related fields in a settings or onboarding form.

patterns.name: preferences-section
patterns.description: A Card wrapping a group of Checkboxes with a section heading.

patterns.name: content-card
patterns.description: A Card presenting a single content item (course, article) with title, metadata, body text, and a CTA Button.
patterns.tree: Card > Stack(gap=md) > [Stack(gap=xs) > [Heading, Text(size=body-small)], Text, Button(variant=neutral, size=sm)]

useWhen.default: Flat surface on the page background. Primary container for form sections and content groups.
useWhen.elevated: Raised surface above the page background. Use for featured content, selected card states, or content that must visually float above siblings.
useWhen.transparent: No fill — keeps Card's border and padding as a grouping outline without separating its background from the page canvas.

rules.case: Mixing Card, CardVertical and CardHorizontal in the same section, list or grid row
rules.because: Card is a generic surface container; CardVertical and CardHorizontal are semantic course cards with fixed layouts. Mixing them in the same list or grid breaks visual rhythm and semantic consistency.
rules.do: Choose one card type per section. Use Card for generic content grouping; use CardVertical or CardHorizontal for course content — never both in the same visual row or list.
